name: api-dev
description: Scaffold, test, document, and debug REST and GraphQL APIs from the command line.

displayDescription.en: Build, test, document, and debug HTTP APIs across the full lifecycle: scaffolding endpoints, curl testing, OpenAPI specs, mocking services, and debugging.
displayDescription.zh: 专注接口全生命周期开发，涵盖端点搭建、自动化测试、OpenAPI文档生成、Mock服务搭建与HTTP请求问题调试，提升开发效率。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me scaffold a REST API endpoint and write test scripts for it.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我搭建一个REST API端点并编写测试脚本
